record.paper_title: Some Recent Results and Open Problems on Sets of Lengths of Krull Monoids with Finite Class Group
record.original_question: Let G be a finite abelian group and let B(G) be the monoid of zero-sum sequences over G. For an element a of B(G), let L(a) be the set of all possible numbers of irreducible factors in factorizations of a, and let L(G) be the resulting system of sets of factorization lengths. Can one determine a function f: N -> N such that, whenever |G| >= f(M), the system L(G) contains every finite set L contained in N_{>=2} whose width max L - min L is at most M?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite abelian group, written additively. A sequence over G is a finite unordered tuple of elements of G (equivalently, an element of the free abelian monoid on G); it is called a zero-sum sequence if the sum of its terms equals 0. Under concatenation, the zero-sum sequences over G form a commutative cancellative monoid B(G), called the monoid of zero-sum sequences over G. An element a ∈ B(G) is irreducible (an atom) if it is non-trivial and cannot be written as a concatenation of two non-trivial zero-sum sequences. For a ∈ B(G), define the set of lengths
   L(a) = { k ∈ N : a = u_1 · … · u_k for some atoms u_1, …, u_k ∈ B(G) },
and set L(G) = { L(a) : a ∈ B(G) }, the system of sets of lengths of B(G).

Determine whether there exists a function f : N → N such that, for every M ∈ N and every finite abelian group G with |G| ≥ f(M), the system L(G) contains every finite subset L ⊂ N_{≥2} satisfying max L − min L ≤ M.
artifact.category_tag: Sets of lengths in Krull monoids
artifact.status_search_result: Searches did not surface a published resolution of this specific realization problem for sets of lengths of bounded width over finite abelian groups. Related realization theorems (e.g., Schmid's realization theorem and subsequent work on characterizations of class groups via sets of lengths) exist, but no source verifies that the function f has been determined or that the statement has been disproved. Status appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of finite abelian groups via sets of lengths in transfer Krull monoids
status_evidence.snippet: Studies which groups are determined by L(G); related characterization results.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work addresses related characterization questions but does not resolve the width-bounded realization problem.

status_evidence.title: A realization theorem for sets of lengths in numerical monoids
status_evidence.snippet: Realization theorem in the numerical-monoid setting.
status_evidence.claim: Realization results exist in related settings, but not directly the bounded-width question for B(G).
